definitions.meaning: A loop Wasl's final live decision marks closed while the simulator's hidden truth says it is not closed. Counted per programme on loops Wasl closed (report7 closure.<programme>.wasl_live_with_review.false_closures; pipeline/report7.go closureStatsDecisions, pipeline/analyze.go closureStatsProg), pooled over seeds, with a Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound (scripts/final_aggregate.py). The frozen run counts false outcomes only; the later evidence-ownership check (#193) is not part of it. The patient drops off the worklist, so this is the dangerous error.
A loop the truth says is closed but Wasl leaves open (closure 'missed'). Rate = 1 - closure recall. It creates extra review or chase work; the patient stays visible.

Two registrations of different people placed in one linker cluster (report7 linkage.false_merge_pairs; pipeline/audit.go linkMetrics). Pair false-match rate = 1 - pair precision. Its clinical consequences are measured separately as false closures and as wrong-patient messages released (an outreach message whose triggering record belongs to someone other than the loop's patient; pipeline/sweep.go govMetrics).
Two registrations of the same person left in different clusters. Pair missed-match rate = 1 - pair recall over all true same-person pairs.
The same two rates at the level of each programme's loops: 1 - closure precision and 1 - closure recall, with the evaluation's 95% t-intervals over five seeds.
Items routed to a human reviewer instead of an automatic decision, per 100 loops, and simulated reviewer hours per 1,000 loops.

Code revision 075abc5ad04a with thresholds, policy v7strict, model and data hashes and seeds [11, 23, 37, 41, 59] recorded in pipeline/results/final/manifest.json, frozen 2026-11-02T04:33Z before the held-out runs. v2 noise was never used for training, calibration or rule design; the v7 rules were designed on earlier v1-noise seeds.

benchmarks.name: FEBRL4 linkage precision, names + DOB
benchmarks.baseline_source: preclink 1.2.0 README benchmark table (recordlinkage recipe in examples/benchmark_febrl.py): https://pypi.org/project/preclink/1.2.0/
benchmarks.note: FEBRL4 (5,000 + 5,000 synthetic Australian records, known 1:1 mapping; not made by the team). Wasl config names_dob: name = given + surname, DOB; no sex, no ID (FEBRL's 7-digit soc_sec_id cannot fill the Emirates-ID slot); encoder, features, LightGBM scorer, 0.7 union threshold and merge rules unchanged; final clusters scored. Wasl 0.979 [0.974, 0.983] (4332/4425), Wilson 95%. Baseline uses address, suburb and postcode (fields Wasl does not have) and blocks on postcode; reproduced exactly by recordlinkage 0.16 rerun by scripts/bench_febrl_recordlinkage.py.

benchmarks.name: FEBRL4 linkage recall, names + DOB + ID (adapted)
benchmarks.baseline_source: preclink 1.2.0 README benchmark table (recordlinkage recipe in examples/benchmark_febrl.py): https://pypi.org/project/preclink/1.2.0/
benchmarks.note: Adaptation: soc_sec_id wrapped into a synthetic 784-prefixed Luhn-valid number so Wasl's Emirates-ID rules apply (equal -> forced link; both valid and different -> never linked). Precision 1.000 [0.999, 1.000] (4561/4561), recall 0.912 [0.904, 0.920] (4561/5000). Every miss is a record whose ID FEBRL corrupted: a valid-looking but wrong ID vetoes the link, which is Wasl's designed behaviour.

benchmarks.name: Arabic-Latin name encoder ROC-AUC, hard negatives
benchmarks.note: Sayedyousef/arabic-name-pairs (CC-BY-4.0; single-token names, merged from JRC-Names, machine translation and an LLM by its author). Name encoder alone, no scorer. 22,489 pairs after removing 183 exact overlaps with the encoder's training pairs. Hard negative: another Arabic name with the same first letter and length within one letter. 95% interval [0.9940, 0.9954] (Hanley-McNeil).

benchmarks.name: Arabic-Latin name encoder top-1 retrieval, Latin to Arabic
benchmarks.note: Sayedyousef/arabic-name-pairs (CC-BY-4.0; single-token names, merged from JRC-Names, machine translation and an LLM by its author). Name encoder alone, no scorer. 22,489 pairs after removing 183 exact overlaps with the encoder's training pairs. Gallery 12,493 Arabic names. Top-1 0.869 [0.864, 0.873] (19534/22486); top-10 (the linker's candidate depth) 0.985 [0.983, 0.986] (22142/22486); Arabic to Latin top-1 0.885 [0.879, 0.890] (11056/12493).

benchmarks.name: Arabic-Latin name encoder precision at a cosine threshold
benchmarks.note: Sayedyousef/arabic-name-pairs (CC-BY-4.0; single-token names, merged from JRC-Names, machine translation and an LLM by its author). Name encoder alone, no scorer. 22,489 pairs after removing 183 exact overlaps with the encoder's training pairs. The runtime has no standalone encoder threshold (cosine feeds top-10 blocking and the scorer), so cosine 0.735 was picked for best F1 on a random 20% of pairs and reported on the other 80% with one hard negative per positive: precision 0.981 [0.978, 0.982] (17719/18070), recall 0.986 [0.984, 0.988] (17719/17970).

benchmarks.name: Arabic-Latin name encoder top-1 retrieval, names never seen in training
benchmarks.note: Strict subset: 1,440 pairs whose English string and every Arabic token never occur as a word in any training name. Smaller gallery (519 Arabic names), so not comparable with the full-set number. Top-1 0.948 [0.935, 0.958] (1365/1440); ROC-AUC hard negatives 0.9978.
